# Audio Translator

Audio translator: translate a recording from your MegaScenes library into another language, spoken in the voices of the original speakers. Podcasts, voice-overs, lessons, up to 8 minutes.

## What it does
Pick a recording from your MegaScenes library and choose the language. Claude tells you the price, which follows the length of the recording, and returns it dubbed in the voices of the original speakers.

**How the files are made:** each audio translation is generated by an audio model. Nothing is made until you say yes, and the price in credits comes first.

Only your own recordings or ones whose speakers agreed, never a famous person's voice.

## Install
In Claude Code:
```
/plugin marketplace add megascenes-app/claude-plugins
/plugin install audio-translator@megascenes
```

## Connecting
- Audio Translator talks to the MegaScenes server at `https://megascenes.com/api/claude/audio-translator/mcp` (Streamable HTTP).
- Connecting opens MegaScenes: sign in, create an account, or continue without one and add your email when you pay (OAuth with PKCE). Then you come straight back to the chat.
- Each audio translation uses credits from your MegaScenes account and is priced before it runs; new accounts can start with a low-cost trial week.
- The translated recording plays in a viewer in the chat where Claude supports interactive apps; in Claude Code you get the link.

## Tools
| Tool | What it does |
|---|---|
| `list_audio_translation_models` | Models for audio translations with settings and starting prices. Read-only. |
| `estimate_audio_translation_cost` | Exact price of one audio translation before it runs. Read-only. |
| `create_audio_translation` | Starts one audio translation in your account. Uses credits; needs sign-in. |
| `get_audio_translation` | Status and file links. Read-only. |
| `list_my_media` | Your recordings and tracks, uploads and files made here, with their length, to pick the one to start from. Read-only. |
| `get_account` | Your plan and credit balance. Read-only. |

## Example prompts
- "Translate my latest MegaScenes recording into Spanish"
- "Turn my podcast clip from my library into French"
- "Translate my last voice-over into German"

## Data and privacy
What you give for the audio translation (the recording you pick from your library and the target language) goes to MegaScenes, stays in your MegaScenes account with the finished file, and is passed to the model provider that makes it. The plugin has no hooks or local scripts and sends nothing else.
